task.title: P6-034: Fix aria-selected misuse for CommandItem multi-select membership
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-034. Size: M. Specs: specs/ui-components.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**`CommandItem`'s `aria-selected` means "keyboard-highlighted", so the set picker's multi-select membership is invisible to assistive tech.** `command.rs:400` sets `aria-selected` from `highlighted` only; `rail.rs:1154-1159` therefore rides membership on `data-selected`, with a comment at `:1150-1153` explaining why. Fixing it properly is a primitive-level change affecting every `command` consumer.
